schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
schemes.description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers. The official scheme page states that an eligible subscriber receives a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60, subject to contributions and scheme terms.
schemes.benefit_summary: Minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60, with an age-based subscriber contribution matched by the Central Government.

application_process: Use New Farmer Registration on the official PM-KISAN portal, or follow the beneficiary-identification process provided by the concerned State/UT.
Authenticate Aadhaar and provide the requested mobile, bank, family, and cultivable-land information.
Provide the exclusion-category self-declaration and any land proof required by the State/UT authority.
Complete mandatory eKYC through OTP on the portal/mobile app, biometric authentication at a CSC/State Seva Kendra, or an officially available face-authentication method.
The State/UT authority verifies landholding and eligibility before approval; use Know Your Status on the official portal to follow the result.

schemes.description: Provides one-time lump sum assistance of Rs 20,000 to BPL households on death of primary breadwinner aged 18-59 years.
schemes.benefit_summary: One-time assistance of Rs 20,000 to bereaved BPL family
schemes.target_group: BPL families who lost primary breadwinner (18-59 years)

eligibility_rules.description: Death of primary breadwinner of the household
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Primary breadwinner is deceased
eligibility_rules.fail_message: NFBS is for families who lost primary breadwinner
eligibility_rules.question: Was the deceased the primary breadwinner of the family?

eligibility_rules.description: Deceased must have been between 18-59 years of age
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Deceased's age was within 18-59 range
eligibility_rules.fail_message: NFBS applies to breadwinner aged 18-59 years at time of death
eligibility_rules.question: What was the age of the deceased at the time of death?

eligibility_rules.description: Family must be living below poverty line
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Family is BPL
eligibility_rules.fail_message: NFBS is for families below poverty line
eligibility_rules.question: Does the family belong to BPL category?

required_documents: Relationship proof between claimant and deceased
Affidavit stating deceased was primary breadwinner
application_process: Apply within specified time limit after death (usually 30-45 days, varies by state)
Obtain application form from Gram Panchayat/ULB
Fill form and attach required documents including death certificate
Submit to local authority
Verification by authorities
One-time payment of Rs 20,000 credited to family member's account

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: Small savings scheme for girl child, offering attractive interest rates and tax benefits under Section 80C. Account can be opened from birth till age 10, with deposits allowed for 15 years, maturing after 21 years from opening.
schemes.benefit_summary: High interest rate (currently 8.2%), tax exemption on deposits (80C), interest, and maturity (EEE status), sovereign guarantee
schemes.target_group: Parents/guardians of girl child up to age 10

eligibility_rules.description: Account must be for a girl child
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Account is for a girl child
eligibility_rules.fail_message: SSY accounts can only be opened for girl children
eligibility_rules.question: Is the account being opened for a girl child?

eligibility_rules.description: Girl child must be below 10 years of age at the time of opening account
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Girl child is below 10 years
eligibility_rules.fail_message: SSY account can only be opened till the girl child is 10 years old
eligibility_rules.question: What is the age of the girl child?

eligibility_rules.description: Maximum 2 accounts allowed per family (one per girl child)
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Within account limit
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Maximum 2 SSY accounts allowed per family
eligibility_rules.question: How many SSY accounts does the family already have?

required_documents: Passport size photographs (girl child and guardian)
application_process: Visit nearest Post Office or authorized bank branch
Fill SSY account opening form
Submit birth certificate and guardian's KYC documents
Make initial deposit (minimum Rs 250)
Receive passbook after account opening
Make annual deposits (minimum Rs 250, maximum Rs 1.5 lakh) for 15 years
schemes.source: Ministry of Finance - National Savings Institute

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: Provides scholarships to wards and widows of deceased/ex-servicemen of Armed Forces, Para-Military Forces, Railway Protection Force, and State Police personnel for professional/technical courses.
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 3,000 per month for boys, Rs 3,500 per month for girls pursuing professional/technical education
schemes.target_group: Wards/widows of Armed Forces, Para-Military, Railway Protection, Police personnel

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be ward/widow of ex-servicemen, deceased/disabled Armed Forces, Para-Military, RPF, or State Police personnel
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Applicant is ward/widow of eligible personnel
eligibility_rules.fail_message: PMSS is for wards/widows of specified defense and police personnel
eligibility_rules.question: Is the applicant a ward or widow of ex-servicemen/Armed Forces/Para-Military/RPF/State Police personnel?

eligibility_rules.description: Minimum 60% marks in 12th standard/equivalent
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Minimum marks requirement met
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Minimum 60% marks required in 12th standard
eligibility_rules.question: What percentage did the applicant score in 12th standard/equivalent?

eligibility_rules.description: Must be pursuing first professional degree in engineering, medical, dental, veterinary, MBA, MCA, etc. from AICTE/MCI/DCI/recognized institution
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Course is eligible for scholarship
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Only professional/technical courses from recognized institutions are eligible
eligibility_rules.question: Is the applicant pursuing a professional degree (BE/BTech/MBBS/BDS/MBA/MCA) from a recognized institution?

required_documents: Ex-servicemen/personnel identity card or service certificate
application_process: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or KSB portal
Fill PMSS application form online
Upload required documents (service certificate, mark sheets, admission proof)
Submit application before deadline (usually October-November)
Verification by Kendriya Sainik Board/concerned department
Scholarship disbursed annually in two installments via DBT
schemes.source: Ministry of Defence - Kendriya Sainik Board

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides soil health cards to farmers every 2-3 years with crop-wise recommendations on nutrients and fertilizers required for individual farm holdings to improve productivity through judicious use of inputs.
schemes.benefit_summary: Free soil testing and health card with customized fertilizer/nutrient recommendations for optimal crop yield

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be a farmer with cultivable agricultural land
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Applicant is a farmer with cultivable land
eligibility_rules.fail_message: SHC is for farmers with agricultural land
eligibility_rules.question: Does the applicant own or cultivate agricultural land?

application_process: Register at nearest Soil Testing Laboratory or Agriculture Department
Alternatively, register online on state agriculture portal
Soil samples collected by trained staff from your field
Samples tested at designated laboratories (12 macro/micro nutrients)
Soil Health Card issued with crop-wise fertilizer recommendations
Card valid for 2-3 years, renewable with fresh testing

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
schemes.description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers (landholding up to 2 hectares) aged 18-40 years, providing minimum pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60.
schemes.benefit_summary: Assured monthly pension of Rs 3,000 after 60 years with age-based monthly contribution matched by Government

eligibility_rules.description: Farmer must have cultivable land up to 2 hectares
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Landholding is up to 2 hectares
eligibility_rules.fail_message: PM-KMY is for small/marginal farmers with up to 2 hectares land
eligibility_rules.question: What is the total cultivable landholding (in hectares)?

eligibility_rules.description: Entry age between 18 and 40 years
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Age is within 18-40 entry range
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Entry age for PM-KMY is 18-40 years
eligibility_rules.question: What is the applicant's age?

eligibility_rules.description: Should not be income tax payer, member of EPFO/ESIC/NPS, or high-income category
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Does not fall under exclusion criteria
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Income tax payers and EPFO/ESIC/NPS members are excluded
eligibility_rules.question: Is the applicant an income tax payer or covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS?

required_documents: Savings bank account passbook or Jan Dhan account
Land records showing landholding up to 2 hectares
application_process: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or use online portal
Provide Aadhaar and land records for verification
Choose pension start date and contribution amount
First contribution paid at enrollment
Auto-debit setup for monthly contributions from linked account
Pension starts after age 60 upon regular contributions

schemes.name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
schemes.description: Provides cooked meals to children in government and government-aided schools from Class I to VIII, aiming to improve nutritional levels and encourage school attendance and retention.
schemes.benefit_summary: Free nutritious cooked meal providing 450 calories and 12g protein (primary), 700 calories and 20g protein (upper primary) during school days
schemes.target_group: Children studying in Classes I-VIII in government/aided schools

eligibility_rules.description: Child must be enrolled in government or government-aided school (Classes I-VIII)
eligibility_rules.pass_message: Child is enrolled in government/government-aided school
eligibility_rules.fail_message: PM POSHAN covers government and government-aided schools only
eligibility_rules.question: Is the child enrolled in a government or government-aided school (Classes I-VIII)?

required_documents: School enrollment proof (not required for access, automatic coverage for enrolled students)
Aadhaar (for attendance tracking in some states)
application_process: No separate application required
Automatic coverage for all children enrolled in government/government-aided schools Classes I-VIII
Meal provided during school days as per state menu
Parents can verify implementation through School Management Committees
schemes.source: Ministry of Education - Department of School Education & Literacy
